definitions.text: (aksje)selskap der medlemmene ved en konkurs bare er ansvarlig for sitt eget aksjeinnskudd, ikke selskapets øvrige gjeld og lignende
definitions.translation: a (joint-stock) company in which, in the event of bankruptcy, the members are liable only for their own share-capital contributions, not for the company's other debts and the like
as distinct from an unlimited-liability company

examples.en: limited companies are companies with limited liability
